title: First steps
description: Open a file, add some text and save it.

steps.title: Open a PDF
steps.text: Start here: open a PDF file from your computer (Ctrl+O), or drop one on the window.

steps.title: Choose the Text tool
steps.text: Click the Text tool, or press T.

steps.title: Place your text
steps.text: Click on the page where the text should go and type. Press Ctrl+Enter to finish.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Save the file to keep your text (Ctrl+S).
